question: The Governor of a State can reserve any bill passed by the state legislature for the consideration of the _______.

options.text: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court
Chief Justice of the High Court

solution:
The correct answer is __**President.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**** Article 200** in The __**Constitution Of India 1949**__

__
 
• Assent to Bills When a Bill has been passed by the Legislative Assembly of a State or, in the case of a State having a Legislative Council, has been passed by both Houses of the Legislature of the State,** **
 
• **it shall be presented to the Governor and the Governor shall declare** either that he assents to the Bill or that he withholds assent therefrom or that he **reserves the Bill for the consideration of the President.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
